The talks covered the outcomes of the U.S. president’s discussions with the Russian leader and China’s leader, as well as further diplomatic efforts to end the war. Kushner said particular attention was given to coordinating the U.S., Germany, Ukraine, and other European partners ahead of the next round of peace negotiations. He also thanked Merz for his continued support of Ukraine, praising his commitment to peace and a strong Euro-Atlantic partnership.
